# Robin Gerth

> Full-stack developer (Angular, Django REST Framework, Shopware 6, REST APIs). Also offers service as a software, web app implementation, agentic coding workshops, software & API audits and MVP development for small and medium-sized businesses. Site available in English (/en) and German (/de).

## Role & focus
- Full-stack developer with hands-on experience in productive business systems: Shopware 6, backend logic, REST APIs, Angular frontends, selected Kotlin adjustments for Android.
- Helps small and medium-sized businesses save time with AI automation, as a part-time side business alongside the employed role.
- Based in the Waldshut district in the German-Swiss border region; available on site for businesses nearby and remotely elsewhere.
- Works in a structured way: clear requirements, traceable decisions, maintainable delivery.
- Uses AI-assisted development tools for research, code analysis and refactoring; engineering judgement and technical control stay with the developer.

## Consulting & automation offers
- **Service as a Software** – recurring work such as reporting, content maintenance or customer enquiries taken over as an automated, predictable service rather than a one-off project.
- **Web app implementation** – custom web applications and internal tools, from the initial requirement through to productive operation.
- **Agentic coding workshops** – hands-on workshops for development teams on integrating AI coding agents into existing workflows in a controlled way.
- **Software & API audits** – reviews of existing systems, interfaces and automations for weaknesses, risks and unused potential.
- **MVP development** – lean, working prototypes that test business assumptions quickly and at manageable effort.
- **Free quick check** – short, no-obligation conversation about where AI and automation pay off in a given business.

## Tech stack
Python, Django, Django REST Framework, Angular, TypeScript, Shopware 6, PHP, Symfony, Kotlin, REST APIs, Linux, Git.

## Case studies
- Internal knowledge management & RAG chatbot – n8n / Qdrant / Microsoft Teams / Entra ID RAG-based chatbot for internal knowledge search with hybrid search and reranking. Internal project built in the employed full-stack developer role at ABC Design, not a client project of the side business.
- Join – Kanban task tool (JavaScript, Firebase).
- DaBubble – Messenger application (Angular, TypeScript, Firebase).
- Videoflix – Full-stack streaming platform (Python, Django REST Framework, Angular).
- El Pollo Loco – Browser game (JavaScript, Canvas, OOP).
